BrochureContent.Content:
Whether you prefer exploring the underground caves, the 12th Century O'Sullivan Mor castle beside the house, ambling through the various woodland walks down to the private bay or relaxing in the mature walled garden - one thing everyone agrees on is that Dunkerron is the essence of peace and relaxation.

The winding driveway leads you to the main house, which is extensive but homely, its Victorian elegance dating from the mid-19th century sits comfortably in the middle of the c. 50 acre woodland estate.

A spacious reception hall leads to a series of bright well-proportioned living spaces many with traditional open fires. The main living room enjoys lovely views of the castle, while the adjoining sunroom offers a quiet place to relax and enjoy the changing landscape throughout the year. The reception rooms suit both family life and entertaining. A large bright vestibule provides additional living space, while the formal dining room can comfortably seat up to sixteen guests. A substantial games room, facing the castle and the walled gardens opens directly onto the lawn through double doors, creating an easy connection between the house and gardens.

To the rear of the property is a cosy bar area, ideal for informal gatherings and a kids bolt hole. The ground floor also includes an ensuite bedroom, offering flexibility for guests or those seeking single-level accommodation. A spacious modern kitchen toward the rear of the house is complemented by a utility room, office and additional service areas.

On the first floor are seven generously sized bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. They enjoy views over the gardens, woodland and the surrounding mountains in the backdrop.

The grounds are a particular feature of the estate. Various woodland pathways lead to the private beach at Kenmare Bay which has huge potential, offering peaceful walks through mature trees to the water's edge. On the way to the bay discover the secret ancient 'Suterín' underground tunnels leading to a large cave. The ruins of Dunkerron Castle provide a unique historic focal point, while the beautifully maintained walled garden adds further character. There is something for everyone here!

In addition to the main residence, there are 3 lodges on the estate. While they require refurbishment, they offer excellent potential for guest accommodation, staff housing or independent residential use, subject to any necessary permissions.

All of this on the Ring of Kerry just 3 miles from the centre of the Cosmopolitan town of Kenmare. Dunkerron presents a rare opportunity to acquire a historic country estate in one of Ireland's most desirable coastal settings. Combining privacy, heritage, generous accommodation and an exceptional nature, it offers significant potential as a private residence, hospitality venture or multi-generational family home.
